name: web-industrial-mobile-cart-with-steel-photo
title: Industrial catalog mobile cart beside moody steel photograph
whatItIs: A split tile: on the left a dark photo of steel pipes and sparks in a workshop, on the right a phone showing an empty-cart state with a grey icon, a blue button, and a deep blue consultation card.
whatItMeans: Practical and trustworthy; the gritty photo grounds the clean interface in real materials.
techniques: Pair a real-world product photo with the matching UI to connect brand and interface.
Design an empty state with a light icon, one sentence and one blue button.
Close the page with a saturated blue call-to-action card.
Keep the interface light and airy against a dark image.

vocabulary.definition: The screen shown when there is no content yet.
Placing photography next to interface to show context.
A coloured block containing a prompt and one button.
Close images of a product's raw materials.
